## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:只改 `packages/platform-objects/CHANGELOG.md` 已发布的 18.5.0 条目里一句话:Add User 重新添加已待激活的地址时「会再次通知托管组织」,补上「被停用的人员除外,此时不发送任何通知」。
- 为什么改:#35164 评论 6974439913 指出该句对被停用的待激活人员不成立(接口回 `host.notified: false`,`reason: 'deactivated'`);AGENTS.md 规定已发布条目的事实错误在原条目上、以单独的 docs-only PR 修正,不搭在代码 PR 上。
- 风险与回滚:纯文档,不发布任何包;回滚即回退本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/platform-objects/CHANGELOG.md` 18.5.0 节 `2e1e3b9` 条目的那一行。
- 两分钟验证:`git diff origin/main -- packages/platform-objects/CHANGELOG.md`,预期只有一行改动。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

The released 18.5.0 entry (`2e1e3b9`) of `packages/platform-objects/CHANGELOG.md` said that on an Add User re-add of an address already pending "the hosting organisation is told again". For a deactivated pending person nothing is sent: `addOnePendingPerson` (`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/pending-sso-users.ts`) answers `alreadyPending: true` with `host: { notified: false, reason: 'deactivated' }`. The sentence now reads "(the hosting organisation is told again, unless the person is deactivated, in which case nothing is sent; either way the position, permission set or manager sent with it is not applied)".

The amendment is made in the released entry itself, in a docs-only PR, as AGENTS.md's Documentation Guardrails require for `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md`: never in a code PR, never as an erratum in a later entry. The code half of #35164 (the Import Users labels) is in the code PR on `claude/issue-34889-identity-outcome-copy`, which carries the card's closing keyword.

`skip-changeset`: this diff declares no release; a changeset here would publish an erratum in a later entry, which the same rule forbids.

## Acceptance notes

- `grep "told again"` over `content/` finds no release-notes page carrying the same sentence; the 18.5.0 entry is the only copy.

## Verification

- `git diff --stat origin/main`: `packages/platform-objects/CHANGELOG.md | 2 +-`, one file.
